mood_contract: Satisfied compounding: the student sees a living system around their challenge, not a folder-setup exercise.

intended_learnings.text: A system is persistence plus automation; a saved document alone is a document and an agent with no files is a chat.
Three layers: raw sources untouched, a memory the agent sharpens, a rules file that keeps the shape of every update.
Plain text, because reading and writing text is what the model does best.
The system keeps getting better the more you feed it; that is what chat cannot do.
